description: This file contains an extension of the OnboardingView in SwiftUI, defining its layout and UI behavior including navigation controls, page management, appearance, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: activePageIndex(for:)
methods.description: Calculates the active page index based on the given cursor, ensuring it stays within valid bounds.

methods.name: reconcilePageForModeChange(previousActivePageIndex:)
methods.description: Adjusts the current page with animation based on the previous active page index when the onboarding mode changes.

methods.name: onboardingPage
methods.description: Wraps content in a styled scroll view suitable for onboarding pages.

methods.name: onboardingCard
methods.description: Provides a visually styled card container with padding, background, and shadow for onboarding content.

methods.name: onboardingGlassCard
methods.description: Provides a transparent, glass-like styled card container with overlay border for onboarding content.

methods.name: featureRow
methods.description: Creates a feature row with a title, subtitle, and system image.

methods.name: featureActionRow
methods.description: Creates a feature row with an action button.

methods.name: featureRowContent
methods.description: Constructs the content layout for feature rows.
